description: This file is a PHP source file that generates a web page for troubleshooting and resetting/restoring a network gateway. It includes PHP code, HTML markup, and JavaScript for user interactions and AJAX calls to perform reset and restore operations.

methods.name: setResetInfo
methods.description: Sends AJAX request to trigger reset or restore operation based on user interaction, and handles UI updates during reboot or Wi-Fi restart.

methods.name: checkForRebooting
methods.description: Polls the server to check if the device has rebooted, redirecting to login page upon success.

methods.name: setBatteryInfo
methods.description: Sends AJAX request to re-establish battery connection.
